display.purpose: Compact balanced hero headline; local variable font with OFL license.

body.purpose: Landing, workspace and reading copy use local Manrope; technical annotations retain monospace. Self-contained generated reports use system sans-serif without new external resources.

shadows.name: command-palette
shadows.purpose: Lift the operational command dialog above otherwise flat white and pearl surfaces.

shadows.name: portfolio-float
shadows.purpose: Illustrative portfolio and sample report receive restrained violet lift; sample report print removes it.

motion.name: action-transition
motion.purpose: Action hover transitions; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: prism-settle
motion.purpose: Decorative ring settles from translateY(16px), rotate(-3deg) and reduced saturation; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Deep rose public-check action with a visible inherited green focus outline.

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Outlined supporting action leading to the sample report.

narrative.overview: The locally built landing follows user-selected alternative 6, approved with ‘la 6 mi piace.’ Pearl surfaces, dark plum Manrope, coral emphasis, lilac panels and local optical artwork define this surface. It supersedes the landing’s earlier agency-journal proposal. The subsequent user approval “ok vai avanti” extends Prism to workspace and all remaining pages: quiet white and pearl operational surfaces, lilac selection and reading panels, rose actions, and preserved semantic statuses. Appearance approval does not authorize deployment.
keyCharacteristics: Pearl ground and dark plum Manrope.
Coral display emphasis with deeper rose actions.
Optical glass ring and softly lifted fictional portfolio overview.
Local font and artwork; responsive stacking and contained table scrolling.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Status color accompanies readable status text; illustrations and fictional data remain explicitly identified.

dos: Do preserve the selected color hierarchy and local assets.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion and fictional-data labels.
Do use 44px operational actions, 46px inputs, violet workspace focus and a wrapping mobile navigation header.
Do preserve self-contained generated-report styling, agency identity, severity text and print rules.
donts: Don't obscure operational evidence, navigation or report print behavior when applying Prism across routes.
Don't present the illustrative overview as delivered dashboard functionality.
Don't interpret appearance approval or the scoped ship review as deployment authorization.
